items.title: Investigating Impurity's Substance and Its Particular Characteristics (continued)

items.zh: 云何尋思不淨共相？謂若內身，外淨色相未有變壞；若在外身，不淨色相已有變壞。由在內身不淨色相平等法性、相似法性，發起勝解，能自了知我淨色相亦有如是同彼法性；若諸有情成就如是淨色相者，彼淨色相亦有如是同彼法性；譬如在外不淨色相。是名尋思不淨共相。云何名為尋思彼品？謂作是思：若我於彼諸淨色相不淨法性不如實知，於內、於外諸淨色相發起貪欲，便為顛倒，黑品所攝，是有諍法，有苦、有害、有諸災患、有遍燒惱。由是因緣，發起當來生老病死愁歎憂苦種種擾惱。若我於彼諸淨色相不淨法性如實隨觀，便無顛倒，白品所攝，是無諍法，無苦、無害，廣說乃至由此因緣，能滅當來生老病死，乃至擾惱。若諸黑品，我今於彼不應忍受，應斷、應遣。若諸白品我今於彼未生應生；生已令住，增長廣大。如是名為尋思彼品。云何名為尋思彼時？謂作是思：若內所有諸淨色相，在現在世；若外所有不淨色相，亦現在世。諸過去世曾淨色相，彼於過去雖有淨相，而今現在如是次第種種不淨。諸現在世我之所有似淨色相，此淨色相於現在世雖有淨相，於未來世不當不淨如今現在外不淨色，無有是處。我此色身，去來今世，曾如是相、當如是相、現如是相，不過如是不淨法性。如是名為尋思彼時。云何名為尋思彼理？謂作是思：若內若外都無有我、有情可得，或說為淨、或說不淨；唯有色相、唯有身形，於中假想施設言論，謂之為淨、或為不淨。又如說言：壽煖及與識，若棄捨身時，離執持而臥，無所思如木。既死沒已，漸次變壞分位可知。謂青瘀等，乃至骨鎖。今我此身，先業煩惱之所引發，父母不淨和合所生，糜飯等食之所增長。此因、此緣、此由藉故，雖暫時有諸淨色相似可了知，而內身中若內若外，於常常時，種種不淨皆悉充滿。如是名依世俗、勝義及以因緣觀待道理尋思彼理。復作是思：於此不淨，若能如是善修、善習、善多修習，能斷欲貪。如是欲貪，定應當斷。如是名依作用道理尋思彼理。復作是思：如世尊說：若於不淨善修、善習、善多修習，能斷欲貪。是至教量。我亦於內自能現見於諸不淨；如如作意思惟修習，如是如是令欲貪纏未生不生，生已除遣。是現證量。比度量法亦有可得。謂作是思：云何今者作意思惟能對治法，可於能治所緣境界煩惱當生？如是名依證成道理尋思彼理。復作是思：如是之法成立法性，難思法性、安住法性。謂修不淨，能與欲貪作斷對治，不應思議、不應分別，唯應信解。如是名依法爾道理尋思彼理。

blocks.text: The rest of the six-fold investigation of impurity. **All of today's Chinese is untranslated**; the commentary summarises it. It shows how insight works, step by step, on a single meditation object.

items: **Shared mark.** One's own body looks clean and has not yet decayed; the corpse outside has. But they share the same nature: "my clean appearance has the same nature as that", and so does that of every being who now looks lovely.

**Category.** If I do not know the impure nature of the lovely, and crave it, "this is distortion, belonging to the dark category", full of strife, suffering, harm, and leading to future birth, ageing, and death. If I see it as it is, "it is without distortion, belonging to the bright category". The dark I should not tolerate; the bright I should develop.

**Time.** What was once lovely in the past is now, in stages, impure. What is lovely in me now cannot fail to become what that corpse is now. "This body of mine, past, future, and present, was, will be, and is of this impure nature."

**Principle.** By **dependence**: inside and out, there is no self or being to be called "clean" or "unclean", only form and shape, named by convention. As the sūtra says: "When life, warmth, and consciousness leave the body, it lies abandoned like a log", and then decays in stages. My body, drawn forth by past karma and affliction, born of the union of parents, grown on rice and food, looks lovely for a while but is always full of impurities. By **function**: cultivating impurity cuts sensual desire. By **proof**: the Buddha said so (scripture); I see for myself that as I practise, desire does not arise or is dispelled (direct perception); and it can be inferred: how could affliction towards an object arise while one attends to its antidote? By **natural law**: that impurity contemplation counters desire is simply the nature of things, "to be accepted with faith, not speculated about".

quiz.q: How does the "shared mark" of impurity relate one's own body to a corpse?
options: One's body is clean and the corpse is not, so they are different
They share the same nature: one's present clean appearance will become what the corpse now is
The corpse is impure only because it is dead
Shared marks apply only to other people's bodies
quiz.why: 能自了知我淨色相亦有如是同彼法性: one realises one's own clean appearance shares the corpse's nature.

quiz.q: In examining "time", what does the practitioner conclude?
options: The body was impure only in the past
Past, future, and present, this body is of the same impure nature
Only the future body will be impure
quiz.why: 我此色身，去來今世，曾如是相、當如是相、現如是相，不過如是不淨法性.

quiz.q: Which of the four principles is applied when the practitioner says "impurity contemplation counters desire; this should be accepted with faith, not speculated about"?
quiz.why: The text calls this 依法爾道理尋思彼理: the nature of things, difficult to conceive, to be accepted rather than analysed.
